tei:div.tei:p: gnyis pa rjes su bzung nas gzhal bya'i gnas gsum la mkhas par byed pa'i yan lag la/ gzhal bya tsam gtan la 'bebs byed tshad ma bshad/ mngon gyur gtan la 'bebs byed mngon sum bshad/ lkog gyur gtan la 'bebs byed rjes dpag bshad pa dang gsum du yod/ dang po ni/ spyir tshad ma de la don gyi tshad ma dang*/ dpe'i tshad ma gnyis/ don gyi tshad ma ni/ tshad ma'i skyes bu la byed/ dpe'i tshad ma ni/ mngon sum dang rjes dpag gnyis la byed/ tshad ma mngon rjes gnyis po de rang bzor byas pa ni ma yin gyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab las gsungs so/ /zhes shes par bya ba'i phyir du slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos tshad ma mdo brtsam pa'i thog mar/

tshad ma gyur pa 'gro la phan bzhed pa// ston pa bder gshegs skyob la phyag 'tshal nas// tshad mar sgrub phyir rang gi gzhung kun las// btus te sna tshogs 'thor rnams 'dir cig bya// zhes bcom ldan 'das la tshad mar gyur pa'i sgo nas bstod phyag mdzad pa yin te/ de lta'i dngos don bstod pa ni// de yi bstan pa nyid las ni// tshad ma'i de nyid grub don te// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ tshad ma mngon rjes gnyis po de bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa yin te/ mdo las/ mig gi rnam par shes pas sngon po shes kyi sngon po'o snyam du ni ma yin no/ /zhes pas dbang po mngon sum de bstan/ dge slong dag gzugs shes pa ni rnam pa gnyis te mig dang yid la brten pa'o/ /zhes pas yid kyi mngon sum de bstan/ sems la sems ma mchis pa ste sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'o/ /zhes pas rang rig mngon sum bstan/ chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba rnam par dag pa thob bo/ /zhes pas rnal 'byor mngon sum de bstan pa'i phyir/ rjes dpag yod pa ma bkag cing*/ rjes dpag gi rten gtan tshigs gsungs pas rjes dpag gsungs par grub pa ste/ rjes su dpag pa ma bzlog phyir// cung zad skye ba'i bdag nyid can// gang de thams cad 'gag chos yin// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das la tshad mar gyur pa'i sgo nas bstod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ gcer bu pa sogs phyi rol pa kha cig tshad ma'i skyes bu mi srid de/ tshad ma'i skyes bu yin na lkog gyur gyi don thams cad shes dgos pa las de shes pa med pa dang*/ de sgrub pa'i thabs med pa dang*/ thabs yod kyang de la nan tan du byed pa med pa'i phyir/ zhes brjod par byed de/ tshad ma lkog gyur don shes yin// de sgrub byed kyang med pa'i phyir// nan tan byed pa yod ma yin// zhes ni kha cig rab tu brjod/ /ces bshad pa'i phyir/ yang phyi rol pa kha cig na re/

khyed kyi ston pa de thams cad mkhyen pa ma yin te/ lkog tu gyur pa'i don mang po ma shes pa dang*/ srin bu'i grangs mi mkhyen pa dang*/ rgyang ring po'i don mthong ba med pa'i phyir/ zhes zer/ dbang phyug pa kha cig ni/ dbang phyug lta bu rtag pa rang byung gi tshad ma yin gyi sgrub byed kyi thabs las byung ba'i tshad ma ni med do/ /zhes zer/ de dag gi log rtog bsal ba'i phyir du nged kyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das de ni rgyu bsam sbyor phun sum tshogs pa thugs nyams su bzhes pa las 'bras bu don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pas sgrub byed ky-i thabs la ltos nas tshad mar gyur pa yin no/ /zhes shes par bya ba'i phyir du mdo'i mchod brjod du don phun sum tshogs pa drug gi sgo nas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa mdzad pa yin no// rgyu bsam sbyor phun sum tshogs pa ni/ bsam pa phun tshogs 'gro la phan bzhed pa dang*/ sbyor ba phun tshogs ston pa gnyis la byed/ 'bras bu don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa ni/ rang don phun tshogs bde bar gshegs dang*/ gzhan don phun tshogs skyob pa gnyis la byed/ phyi rol pa de dag gi lan la/ rnam 'grel las/ tshad ma rtag pa nyid yod min// dngos yod rtogs pa tshad phyir dang*/ /zhes dang*/ blang dang dor bya'i de nyid ni// thabs dang bcas pa rigs mdzad pa// gang de tshad ma nyid 'dod kyi// thams cad rig mdzad ma yin no/ /zhes dang*/ 'di yi srin bu'i grangs mkhyen pa// nged la 'gar yang nyer mkho med/ /ces dang*/ gal te ring mthong tshad yin na// tshur shog bya rgod brten par gyis/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ rigs gter las/ dgos pa'i don kun shes pa la// mkhas rnams thams cad mkhyen ces zer// thams cad 'dus nas nyan pa la// ba lang med pa skyon ma yin/ /zhes bshad pa yin no// 'o na/ tshad mar gyur pa zhes pa'i tshad ma de gang zhe na/ de ni 'jug yul la bslu ba med pa can gyi shes pa zhig yin no/

/zhes 'chad par byed pa la/ tshad ma bslu med can shes pa/ /zhes pa 'di byung*/ bslu ba med pa'i don de gang zhe na/ rang gi 'jug yul la don byed nus par gnas pa la byed pa yin no/ /zhes 'chad par byed pa la/ don byed nus par gnas pa ni// mi bslu/ zhes pa 'di byung ba yin no// 'o na tshad mar 'jog pa la de tsam gyis chog gam zhe na/ ma shes don gsal gyi rig pa yin pa zhig kyang dgos so/ /zhes 'chad par byed pa la/ ma shes don gyi gsal byed kyang*/ /zhes pa 'di byung*/ 'o na de'i don gang yin zhe na/ de ni rang gi gzhal bya sngar ma shes gsar du shes pa zhig la byed pa yin no/ /zhes 'chad par byed pa la/ rang gi mtshan nyid mi shes pa// shes pa gang yin zhes dgongs phyir/ /zhes pa 'di byung*/ des na bcom ldan 'das chos can/ tshad ma yin te/ mi bslu ba dang ma shes don gsal gnyis ldan gyi rig pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad par byed la/ de ldan bcom ldan tshad ma nyid/ /ces pa 'di byung*/ 'o na gyur pa zhes gsungs pa'i don gang yin zhe na/ de ni sgrub byed kyi thabs la ltos nas tshad mar 'khrungs pa yin no/ /zhes 'chad par byed pa la/ ma skyes pa ni zlog don du// gyur pa nyid gsungs de yi phyir// sgrub byed la ltos tshad yin rigs/༷ /zhes pa 'di byung*/ 'o na phan bzhed pa de ji lta bu zhig yin zhe na/ de ni brtse ba snying rje chen po skye ba du mar goms pa zhig yin no/ /zhes 'chad par byed pa la/ rnam pa du mar thabs mang po// yun ring dus su goms pa las// de la skyon dang yon tan dag/ rab tu gsal ba nyid du 'gyur// des na thugs kyang gsal ba'i phyir// rgyu yi bag chags spangs pa yin// thub chen gzhan don 'jug can gyi// bse ru la sogs khyad 'di yin/ /zhes pa 'di byung*/ 'o na ston pa de ji lta bu yin zhe na/ de ni bden bzhi mi rtag sogs bcu drug mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab zhig la byed pa yin no/

/zhes 'chad par byed pa la/ de don phyir na thabs goms pa// de nyid ston pa yin par 'dod// grub las dang po 'byung ba'i phyir// gnyis po 'di ni rgyu ru bshad// ces pa'i gzhung 'di byung*/ 'o na bder gshegs de ji lta bu zhe na/ de ni rgyu kun 'byung gi bag chags ma lus par spangs pa'i spangs pa khyad par gsum ldan zhig yin no/ /zhes 'chad par byed pa la/ rgyu spangs yon tan gsum bde gshegs// nyid yin// zhes pa 'di byung*/ 'o na skyob pa de ji lta bu zhe na/ de ni rang gis ji ltar gzigs pa'i lam gzhan la ston par mdzad pa zhig yin no/ /zhes 'chad par byed pa la/ skyob pa de ji lta bu zhe na/ de ni nyid gzigs lam gsungs pa// 'bras med phyir na rdzun mi gsung*// zhes pa 'di byung*/ des na bcom ldan 'das tshad mar grub pa yin no/ /zhes 'chad par byed pa la/ de phyir tshad yin/ /zhes pa 'di byung*/ de yan chad kyis ni mdo'i mchod brjod kyi don lugs 'byung du bshad pa'i sgo nas bcom ldan 'das tshad mar bsgrub pa yin la/ mdo'i mchod brjod kyi don lugs zlog tu bshad pa'i sgo nas bcom ldan 'das tshad mar sgrub pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das chos can/ skyob pa yin te/ bden bzhi phyin ci ma log par ston par mdzad pa po yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad par byed pa la/ yang na skyob// bden pa bzhi ni ston mdzad pa'o// zhes pa'i gzhung 'di byung*/ bstan bya bden pa bzhi ni/ shes bya sdug bsngal gyi bden pa/ spang bya kun 'byung gi bden pa/ thob bya 'gog pa'i bden pa/ rgyud la bsten bya lam gyi bden pa dang bzhi la byed cing*/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa ni nad dang 'dra ba dang*/ kun 'byung gi bden pa ni nad kyi rgyu dang 'dra ba dang*/ 'gog pa'i bden pa ni nad dang bral ba dang 'dra ba dang*/ lam gyi bden pa ni nad spong bar byed pa'i sman dang 'dra ba yin te/ rgyud bla mar/ nad ni shes bya nad kyi rgyu ni spang bya la//

bder gnas thob bya sman ni bsten par bya ba ltar// sdug bsngal rgyu dang de 'gog pa dang de bzhin lam// shes bya spang bya reg par bya zhing bsten par bya// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ de ltar bden pa bzhi yod pa las/ dang po sdug bsngal gyi bden pa 'chad par byed pa la/ sdug bsngal 'khor ba can phung po// goms las 'dod chags sogs gsal ba// zhes sogs byung*/ kun 'byung gi bden pa 'chad par byed pa la/ re 'ga' ba nyid yin pas na// sdug bsngal 'di rgyu bcas nyid grub/ /ces sogs byung*/ 'gog pa'i bden pa 'chad par byed pa la/ de ni gtan du ba min te// rgyu la gegs sogs srid phyir ro// zhes sogs byung*/ lam gyi bden pa 'chad par byed pa la/ bshad zin lam de goms pa las// gnas gyur gal te gnas gyur kyang*// zhes sogs byung*/ skyob pa sogs phyi ma phyi ma las bde bar gshegs pa sogs snga ma snga ma sngon song du sgrub pa yin no/ /zhes 'chad par byed pa la/ skyob pa nyid gzigs dang bstan dang*// ma lus khyad par mkhyen par grub// ces sogs byung*/ des na bcom ldan 'das tshad mar grub pa yin no zhes 'chad par byed pa la/ gang phyir des na tshad ma nyid/ /ces pa 'di byung*/ 'o na tshad ma tsam gyi mtshan nyid gang yin zhe na/ 'di la bzhed pa'i rnam grangs bkod pa dang*/ rang gi lugs bzhag pa gnyis/ dang po/ slob dpon lha dbang blo ltar na/ tshad ma bslu med can shes pa/ /zhes pas mi bslu ba'i rig pa tshad ma'i mtshan nyid du bstan/ ma shes don gyi gsal byed kyang*/ /zhes pas ma shes don gsal gyi rig pa tshad ma'i mtshan nyid du bstan zhing*/ de gnyis ka'ang tshad ma'i mtshan nyid rnam grangs pa yin no/ /zhes 'chad/ slob dpon rgyan mkhan po ltar na/ tshad ma bslu med can shes pa/ /zhes pas tha snyad pa'i tshad ma'i mtshan nyid bstan/ ma shes don gyi gsal byed kyang*/ /zhes pas don dam pa'i mtshan nyid bstan pa yin no/ /zhes 'chad par byed de/

rigs gter las/ mi bslu ma shes don gsal gnyis/ /rnam grangs pa'am phye ste smra/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ lugs dang po la rigs gter bas skyon brjod pa ni/ 'o na mtshon bya tshad ma'i tha snyad de khyab che chung tha dad pa gnyis su thal/ de la mtshan nyid khyab che chung tha dad pa gnyis 'jog pa 'thad pa'i phyir/ zhes brjod par mdzad pa yin te/ rigs gter las/ mtshan nyid gnyis kyis 'jog na ni// mtshon bya de yang gnyis su 'gyur// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ slob dpon rgyan mkhan po'i lugs de la rigs gter pas skyon brjod pa ni/ 'o na rnam 'grel 'dir tshad ma spyi'i mtshan nyid ston byed kyi gzhung mi srid pa thal/ tshad ma bslu med can shes pa/ /zhes pas tha snyad pa'i tshad ma'i mtshan nyid bstan nas/ tshad ma spyi'i mtshan nyid ma bstan/ ma shes don gyi gsal byed kyang*// zhes pas ni don dam pa'i tshad ma'i mtshan nyid bstan nas tshad ma spyi'i mtshan nyid ma bstan pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad par byed de/ rigs gter las/ mtshan mtshon gnyis su 'dod na yang*// spyi mtshan cig pa mi srid 'gyur/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ slob dpon chos mchog ni/ rnam nges las/ 'di dag gi don yongs su dpyad nas zhugs pa na don bya ba la bslu ba med pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa la brten nas/ mi bslu ba khyad par gsum ldan de tshad ma'i mtshan nyid du 'chad par byed/ khyad par gsum ni/ ngo bo'i khyad par/ yul gyi khyad par/ byed las kyi khyad par dang gsum la byed/ de yang ngo bo'i khyad par dang*/ yul gyi khyad par gnyis kyis tshad ma'i mtshan nyid kyi mi srid pa'i skyon sel bar byed/ byed las kyi khyad par gyis ni khyab ches pa'i skyon sel bar byed/ ma khyab pa gcod tshul ni zur nas kha skong dgos pa yin no/ /zhes 'chad par byed/ de la rigs gter mdzad pas skyon brjod pa ni/ de ni mi 'thad de/ tshad ma'i mtshan nyid dang byed las so sor 'byed pa gzhung gi dgongs pa ma yin zhing*/

ma khyab pa gcod tshul zur nas kha bskang dgos nas mtshan nyid snga ma de nyid skyon can du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ zhes 'chad par byed de/ rigs gter las/ gnyis su 'byed pa dgongs pa min// ma khyab gcod tshul 'dir mi 'thad// ces bshad pa'i phyir/ slob dpon bram ze chen po ni/ bden pa'i don rtogs chos gsum ldan de/ tshad ma'i mtshan nyid yin/ chos gsum ni/ yul gyi khyad par/ 'dzin stangs kyi khyad par/ byed las kyi khyad par dang gsum la byed do/ /zhes 'chad par byed/ de la rigs gter bas skyon brjod pa ni/ bden pa'i don rtogs chos gsum ldan tshad ma'i mtshan nyid du 'jog pa mi 'thad de/ de la mi dgos pa dang*/ ma khyab pa dang*/ mi srid pa'i skyon gsum yod pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad par byed de/ rigs gter las/ mi dgos ma khyab mi srid gsum// bden pa'i don rtogs 'dod na yod/ /ces bshad pa'i phyir/ rngog lo chen po ni/ slob dpon chos mchog dang mthun par bzhed/ slob dpon phywa pa ni/ bram ze chen po dang mthun par 'chad/ rigs gter ba rang gi lugs la ni/ gzhung snga phyi sdoms nas mi bslu ba dang ma shes don gsal gnyis tshogs kyi rig pa tshad ma'i mtshan nyid yin te/ rigs gter las/ mi bslu ma shes don gsal gnyis// rang mtshan rtogs pa don la mthun/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rang gi lugs la/ tshad ma la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ 'gal zla tshad min gyi blo bshad pa dang gsum du yod/ dang po ni/ dang por yongs su dpyad pa'i don la mi bslu ba'i rig pa tshad ma'i mtshan nyid yin/ 'o na tshad ma mi bslu ba'i rig pa de rang gis rtogs pa'am tshad ma gzhan la brten nas rtogs pa yin zhe na/ rang gi ngo bo rig pa de ni rang nyid kyis mngon sum du rtogs pa yin la/ 'jug yul la mi bslu ba yin pa de la rang nyid kyis nges pa dang*/ tshad ma gzhan la brten nas nges dgos pa gnyis su yod do/ /zhes 'chad par byed

pa la/ rang las rang gi ngo bo rtogs// tha snyad las ni tshad ma nyid/ /ces pa 'di byung*/ 'dir rang nges gzhan nges kyi tshad ma'i rnam par bzhag pa la/ kha cig ni/ tshad ma'i tha snyad la nges pa rang stobs kyis 'dren nus pa dang mi nus pa la byed zer/ kha cig ni/ rang gi 'jug yul la nges pa rang stobs kyis 'dren nus pa dang mi nus pa la byed zer/ bod phyi ma kha cig ni/ rang gi gzhal bya'i bdag nyid yul steng na gnas pa med na rang nyid mi 'byung ba la nges pa rang stobs kyis 'dren nus pa dang mi nus pa la rang las nges dang gzhan las nges kyi tshad mar 'jog pa yin no zer/ rang las nges kyi tshad ma de la rigs gter ba ltar na/ don byed snang can gyi mngon sum/ goms pa can gyi mngon sum/ rang rig mngon sum/ rjes dpag dang bzhir yod de/ rigs gter las/ don rig gnyis dang rang rig dang*// rjes su dpag rnams rang las nges/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gzhan las nges kyi tshad ma de la/ dang po pa dang*/ yid ma gtad dang*/ 'khrul rgyu can gyi mngon sum dang gsum du yod de/ rigs gter las/ dang po pa dang yid ma gtad// 'khrul rgyu can rnams gzhan las nges// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ slob dpon chos mchog ltar na/ gzhan las nges kyi tshad ma de la/ snang ba rang las nges shing bden pa gzhan las nges pa dang*/ spyi rang las nges shing khyad par gzhan las nges pa dang*/ snang ba nyid kyang gzhan las nges pa dang gsum du yod/

dang po ni/ don la me yin zhing rtog pas me yin min the tshom za dus kyi kha dog dmar 'bar ba 'dzin pa'i mngon sum lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa spyi rang las nges shing khyad par gzhan las nges pa ni/ don la sha pa yin zhing rtog pas sha pa yin min the tshom za dus kyi nags tshal gyi kha dog 'dzin pa'i mngon sum lta bu la byed/ gsum pa snang ba nyid kyang gzhan las nges pa ni/ nya phyis la dngul du 'khrul dus kyi nya phyis kyi kha dog 'dzin pa'i mngon sum lta bu la byed do// slob dpon phywa pas de la skyon brjod par mdzad cing*/ rang gi lugs la/ gzhan las nges kyi tshad ma ni/ snang ba rang las nges shing bden pa'i cha gzhan las nges pa'i mngon sum kho na yin no/ /zhes zer/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ tshad ma de la gzhal bya 'jal tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ mngon sum dang rjes dpag gnyis su grangs nges te/ tshad ma'i gzhal bya la rang mtshan dang spyi mtshan gnyis su grangs nges pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad par byed pa la/ tshad ma mdor/ mngon sum dang ni rjes su dpag/ tshad ma'o mtshan nyid gnyis gzhal bya// de la rab sbyor phyir tshad ma// gzhan ni yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes dang*/ rnam 'grel las/ gzhal bya gnyis phyir tshad ma gnyis/ /zhes dang*/ rigs gter las/ gzhal bya gnyis phyir tshad ma gnyis// de la grangs gzhan bkag phyir ro// zhes pa rnams byung*/ tshad ma mngon rjes gnyis kyi dbye gzhi ni yang dag pa'i shes pa la byed pa yin te/ rigs gter las/ des na yang dag shes pa nyid/ /tshad ma yin phyir dbye gzhir 'thad/ /ces bshad pa'i phyir/ tshad ma la mngon rjes gnyis su grangs nges pa'i don ni/ tshad ma mngon rjes gnyis las grangs mang mi dgos shing nyung na mi 'du ba la byed/ tshad ma la mngon rjes gnyis las grangs mang mi dgos te/ tshad ma yin na mngon rjes gang rung yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ mngon rjes gnyis las nyung na mi 'du ba yin te/ tshad ma la mngon rjes gnyis ka srid pa'i phyir/

tshad ma mngon rjes gnyis su grangs nges par sgrub dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rgyang 'phen pa tshad ma mngon sum gcig kho nar 'dod pa dang*/ rang sde kha cig tshad ma la mngon rjes gnyis kyi steng du lung tshad ma dang gsum du 'dod pa dang*/ kha cig de'i steng du sgra byung gi tshad ma dang bzhir 'dod pa dang*/ mu stegs tsa ra ka pa ni bcu gcig tu 'dod pa sogs/ log par rtog pa du ma yod pa las/ de dag bsal ba'i phyir tshad ma la mngon rjes gnyis su grangs nges par sgrub par mdzad pa yin te/ gsum gcig grangs ni bsal ba yin/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gzhal bya rang spyi gnyis su grangs nges pa'i rtags kyis tshad ma la mngon rjes gnyis su grangs nges par sgrub pa'i phyogs chos sgrub pa ni/ shes bya chos can/ gzhal bya rang spyi gnyis su grangs nges pa yin te/ gzhal bya la don dam par don byed nus pa dang mi nus pa gnyis su grangs nges pa'i phyir/ 'dra ba thun mong ba dang mi 'dra ba thun mong ma yin pa gnyis su grangs nges pa'i phyir dang*/ rjod byed sgra'i yul yin pa dang ma yin pa gnyis su grangs nges pa'i phyir dang*/ yul can gyi blo la yang brda dang rtsol ba sogs la ltos pa dang mi ltos pa'i blo gnyis su grangs nges pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad par byed pa la/ don byed nus dang mi nus phyir// 'dra dang mi 'dra nyid phyir dang*// sgra'i yul dang yul min phyir// rgyu mtshan gzhan ni yod pa na// blo ni yod dang med phyir ro/ /zhes pa 'di byung*/ gzhal bya la rang spyi gnyis su grangs nges na tshad ma la mngon rjes gnyis su grangs nges pas khyab pa yang yin te/ tshad ma'i 'jug yul la mngon gyur dang lkog gyur gnyis su grangs nges pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad par byed la/ mngon sum lkog tu gyur pa las// gzhal bya gzhan ni yod ma yin/ /zhes pa 'di byung*/ gsum pa tshad min gyi blo la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/

tshad ma'i 'gal zlar gyur pa'i rig pa de/ tshad min gyi blo'i mtshan nyid yin/ de la slob dpon phywa pa ltar na/ yid dpyod/ snang la ma nges pa/ dpyad shes/ log shes/ the tshom dang lngar yod pa yin te/ rigs gter las/ yid dpyod snang la ma nges pa// dpyad shes log shes the tshom lnga// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ de la rigs gter bas skyon brjod pa ni/ yid dpyod dang*/ dpyad shes/ snang la ma nges pa gsum/ blo rigs zur du 'chad pa mi 'thad de/ yid dpyod ni the tshom gyi nang du 'dus pa dang*/ dpyad shes ni dran pa'i nang du 'dus pa dang*/ snang la ma nges pa la mngon sum kyang srid pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad par byed de/ rigs gter las/ yid dpyod rtags las gtan mi ltos// dam bca' tsam yin the tshom gyur// zhes sogs bshad pa'i phyir/ rigs gter ba rang gi lugs ni/ tshad min gyi blo la ma rtogs log rtog the tshom dang gsum du yod de/ rigs gter las/ ma rtogs log rtog the tshom ste// tshad ma'i 'gal zla rnam pa gsum// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ ma rtogs pa'i blo la/ yul la ma zhugs nas ma rtogs pa dang*/ zhugs kyang ma rdzogs pas ma rtogs pa dang*/ rdzogs kyang ma rnyed nas ma rtogs pa dang gsum du yod de/ rigs gter las/ ma zhugs pa dang ma rdzogs dang*// rdzogs par gyur kyang ma rnyed pa'o// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ log rtog la dbye na/ rtog pa log shes dang*/ rtog med log shes gnyis/ dang po la/ yul la log par rtog pa dang*/ dus la log par rtog pa dang*/ rnam pa la log par rtog pa dang gsum du yod/ dang po ni/ nor bu'i 'od la nor bur 'dzin pa'i blo lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa dus la log par rtog pa ni/ nyin phyed la mtshan phyed du 'dzin pa'i blo lta bu la byed/ gsum pa rnam pa la log par rtog pa ni/ thag khra la sbrul du 'dzin pa'i blo lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa rtog med log shes la dbye na/ yid shes bslad pa dang*/

dbang shes 'khrul pa gnyis su yod de/ rtog med la'ang yid dbang gnyis/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ dang po ni/ rmi lam gsal snang gi shes pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa dbang shes 'khrul pa ni/ zla ba gnyis snang gi dbang shes lta bu la byed/ the tshom la dbye na/ mngon gyur dang*/ bag la nyal dang*/ cha mnyam pa dang*/ shas cher 'dzin pa dang bzhir yod de/ mngon du gyur dang bag la nyal// cha mnyam pa dang shas cher 'dzin// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mngon gyur gtan la 'bebs byed mngon sum bshad pa la/ mngon sum yang dag bshad pa dang*/ log phyogs mngon sum ltar snang bshad pa/ mngon sum tshad ma'i 'bras bu sgrub byed dang bcas te bshad pa gsum du yod/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ bzhed pa'i rnam grangs bkod pa dang*/ rang gi lugs bzhag pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ slob dpon phywa pa ltar na/ rtog pa dang bral zhing ma 'khrul ba'i rig pa mngon sum gyi mtshan nyid dang*/ myong bas sgro 'dogs bcad pa mngon sum tshad ma'i mtshan nyid yin/ zhes 'chad par byed/ bod phyi ma dag /rtog pa dang bral zhing ma 'khrul ba'i rig pa mngon sum gyi mtshan nyid du bshad pa ni mdo sde pa'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ rnam rig pa ltar na/ dbang yid kyi mngon sum khas len kyang*/ de gnyis 'khrul shes su 'chad dgos pa yin no/ /zhes zer/ gnyis pa rang gi lugs ni/ rtog pa dang bral zhing ma 'khrul ba'i rig pa mngon sum gyi mtshan nyid yin te/ mdo las/ ming dang rigs sogs sbyor ba yi// rtog pa dang bral mngon sum mo/ /zhes dang*/ rnam 'grel las/ mngon sum rtog dang bral bar ni// mngon sum nyid kyis 'grub par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ rigs gter las/ mngon sum rtog bral ma 'khrul ba// nyid kyis tshad mar 'grub pa yin// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ 'o na rtog pa dang bral ba'i don dang*/ ma 'khrul ba'i don ji lta bu yin zhe na/ rtog pa dang bral ba'i don ni/

sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa ma yin pa la byed/ de yang rung ba zhes smos pas ni/ brda la ma byang ba'i byis pa'i rgyud kyi rtog pa rnams sdud par byed pa yin no/ /ma 'khrul ba'i don ni/ mdo sde pa ltar na/ 'phral gyi 'khrul rgyu bzhi po gang rung gis 'khrul par ma bskyed pa la byed/ sems tsam pa ltar na/ ma rig bag chags kyi dbang gis 'khrul par ma bskyed pa la byed/ rigs gter las ni/ gsal bar snang bas rtog med 'grub// rang mtshan 'dzin phyir 'khrul pa med// ces bshad/ 'phral gyi 'khrul rgyu bzhi ni/ 'khrul rgyu rten la yod pa/ yul la yod pa/ gnas la yod pa/ de ma thag rkyen la yod pa dang bzhi la byed/ dang po/ rab rib can la skra shad du snang ba lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ 'gal me 'khor lor snang ba'i dbang shes lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ ljon shing 'gro snang gi dbang shes lta bu/ bzhi pa ni/ zhe sdang gi dbang gis sa gzhi dmar por snang ba'i dbang shes lta bu byed do// rnam nges las/ rab rib dang*/ myur du bskor ba dang*/ grur zhugs pa dang*/ 'khrugs pa la sogs pas 'khrul par ma bskyed cing*/ zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ des na mngon sum du 'jog pa la ma 'khrul ba'i rig pa yin pa tsam gyis chog kyang*/ rtog bral smos pas ni phyi rol pa kha cig /dbang shes rtog par 'dod pa yod pas de dag bsal ba'i phyir du rtog bral smos pa yin no// gnyis pa dbye ba la/ yul gyi sgo nas dbye ba/ rten gyi sgo nas dbye ba/ gang zag gi sgo nas dbye ba dang gsum du yod de/ yul dang rten dang gang zag gi/ sgo nas mngon sum rnam par dbye// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ yul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ yul rang rig pa rang rig mngon sum dang*/ rnal 'byor mngon sum rnam pa gnyis/ yul gzhan rig pa dbang yid kyi mngon sum gnyis rnams su yod/ rten gyi sgo nas dbye na/ rten dbang po la brten pa dbang yid kyi mngon sum/

gzhan dbang la brten pa rang rig mngon sum dang*/ ting nge 'dzin la brten pa rnal 'byor mngon sum rnams su yod/ gang zag gi sgo nas dbye na/ so so skye bo'i mngon sum dang*/ 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi mngon sum gnyis su yod/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ dbang po'i mngon sum/ yid kyi mngon sum/ rang rig mngon sum/ rnal 'byor mngon sum dang bzhir yod de/ rigs gter las/ ma 'khrul ba ste rnam pa bzhi// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ rigs gter ba ltar na/ mngon sum la bzhir dbye ba de mdo sde pa'i lugs dang*/ bye brag tu smra bas rang rig khas mi len pas mngon sum gsum du 'dod pa dang*/ rnam rig pas dbang yid kyi mngon sum gnyis khas mi len pas mngon sum gnyis su 'dod pa yin no/ /zhes 'chad par byed pa yin te/ rigs gter las/ mngon sum bzhi po mdo sde'i lugs// bye brag smra gsum rnam rig gnyis// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ de dag gi rgyu mtshan ni/ bye brag tu smra bas rang rig khas mi len te/ mdzod las/ kun rdzob gcig pu'i rang tshogs las// gzhan ni bdag med nyid rig 'gyur// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ rnam rig pas dbang yid kyi mngon sum khas mi len te/ des phyi rol gyi don khas mi len pa'i phyir te/ 'grel pa don gsal las/ 'di ni sems tsam kho na yin gyi phyi rol gyi don med do/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ zhes zer/ rang gi lugs ni/ mdo sems gnyis kas mngon sum bzhi ka khas len pa yin no// dbang po'i mngon sum la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sgra bshad/ rkyen gsum ngos bzung ba dang bzhir yod/ dang po ni/ rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen dbang po gzugs can pa la brten nas ma 'khrul ba'i rig pa de/ dbang po'i mngon sum gyi mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ gzugs 'dzin dbang po'i mngon sum nas reg bya 'dzin pa'i dbang po'i mngon sum gyi bar lnga yod/ de dag gi mtshan nyid ni/

rang gi bdag rkyen mig gi dbang po gzugs can pa la brten nas ma 'khrul ba'i rig pa de/ gzugs 'dzin dbang po'i mngon sum gyi mtshan nyid yin pa nas/ rang gi bdag rkyen lus kyi dbang po gzugs can pa la brten nas ma 'khrul ba'i rig pa de/ reg bya 'dzin pa'i dbang po'i mngon sum gyi mtshan nyid yin pa'i bar du shes par bya ba yin no// gsum pa sgra bshad ni/ 'o na dbang po'i mngon sum de rkyen gsum ka las skyes par 'dra ba la/ bdag rkyen kho na'i ming gis 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ de'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ bdag rkyen de de'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir te/ mdo las/ thun mong ma yin rgyu yi phyir// de yi tha snyad dbang pos byas// zhes bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ rigs gter las/ thun mong ma yin rgyu yi phyir// dbang shes yin te rnga sgra bzhin// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa rkyen gsum ngos bzung ba la/ rkyen gsum ni/ de ma thag rkyen/ bdag rkyen/ dmigs rkyen dang gsum du yod/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi de ma thag 'bras su gyur pa'i shes pa de myong ba gsal rig gi ngo bor bskyed par byed pa de/ mtshungs pa de ma thag rkyen gyi mtshan nyid yin te/ rang don rjes 'gro don ltos can// dbang skyes blo ni rgyu yin no// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dper brjod ni/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad gcig dang po de gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig gnyis pa'i de ma thag rkyen yin pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa bdag rkyen la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi bdag 'bras su gyur pa'i shes pa de yul 'dzin nus su bskyed par byed pa de/ bdag rkyen gyi mtshan nyid yin te/ shes pa'i rnam pa 'jog nus pa'i// rgyu nyid la ni gzung bar shes// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/gnyis pa dper brjod ni/ gzugs des gzugs 'dzin mngon sum la gzugs kyi rnam pa gtod par byed pa lta bu la byed/

de dag ni mdo sde pa'i lugs yin la/ sems tsam pa ltar na/ don snang gi shes pa de rkyen gsum las skye yang*/ rkyen gsum ni/ kun gzhi'i steng gi sa bon gyi nus pa nyid la 'chad pa yin te/ rang gi rnam shes rten gyi nus de la// dbang po gzugs can mig ces bya bar rtog/ ces bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yid mngon la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ skye tshul/ yid mngon mi 'thad pa'i rtsod pa spang ba/ bdag rkyen ngos bzung ba dang lngar yod/ dang po ni/ rang gi de ma thag rkyen dbang po'i rnam par shes pa la brten nas rang gi gzung don la rtog pa dang bral zhing ma 'khrul ba'i rig pa de/ yid mngon gyi mtshan nyid yin te/ de phyir dbang po'i rnam par shes// de ma thag rkyen las byung can/ /zhes dang*/ tshad ma mdor/ yid kyang don dang*/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ gzugs 'dzin yid mngon nas reg 'dzin yid mngon gyi bar lngar yod/ de dag gi mtshan nyid ni/ rang gi de ma thag rkyen gzugs 'dzin dbang po'i rnam shes la brten nas rang gi gzung don gzugs la rtog pa dang bral zhing ma 'khrul ba'i rig pa de/ gzugs 'dzin yid mngon gyi mtshan nyid yin pa nas/ rang gi de ma thag rkyen reg bya 'dzin pa'i dbang po'i rnam par shes pa la brten nas rang gi gzung don reg bya la rtog pa dang bral zhing ma 'khrul ba'i rig pa de/ reg bya 'dzin pa'i yid mngon gyi mtshan nyid yin pa'i bar shes par bya ba yin no//

gsum pa skye tshul la/ gzhan gyi bzhed pa bkod pa dang*/ rang gi lugs bzhag pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ slob dpon rgyan mkhan po ltar na/ dang po dbang mngon skad cig ma gcig skye/ de'i rjes su yid mngon skad cig ma gcig skye ba sogs dbang mngon dang yid mngon spel ma kho nar skye ba yin no/ /zhes zer/ slob dpon chos mchog ni/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma lnga skye/ lnga las mang ba mi skye ba de'i tshe na gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma lnga pa'i rgyun mtha' kho nar gzugs 'dzin yid mngon skad cig ma gcig skye ba yin no/ /zhes 'chad par byed/ lugs de gnyis la rigs gter bas skyon brjod pa ni/ spel ma dang ni rgyun gyi mtha'// gnyis ka la yang gnod byed yod// ces bshad pa yin no//slob dpon bram ze chen po dang*/ rngog lo tsā' ba ni/ dbang mngon skad cig dang po sngon du btang nas/ dbang mngon skad cig gnyis pa/ yid mngon skad cig dang po dang*/ de gnyis nyams su myong ba'i rang rig mngon sum gcig ste mngon sum gsum cig car du skye ba yin no/ /zhes 'chad par byed/ rigs gter mdzad pa ni/ don de nyid zhal gyis bzhes nas 'gros gsum pa zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad de/ des na mngon sum 'gros gsum pa// rang rig yin phyir rgyud gzhan med// ces bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rang gi lugs ni/ bram ze chen po dang rjes su mthun par khas len pa yin no// bzhi pa yid kyi mngon sum mi 'thad pa'i rtsod pa spang ba ni/ rtsod pa dang*/ lan gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mu stegs rna ba ma phug pa na re/ yid kyi mngon sum des rang gi de ma thag rkyen du gyur pa'i dbang mngon gyis bzung zin pa'i don 'dzin nam ma bzung ba'i don 'dzin/ dang po ltar na/ yid mngon tshad ma ma yin par 'gyur la/ gnyis pa ltar na long bas kyang gzugs mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes 'chad par byed de/ sngar myong ba ni 'dzin pa na//

yid ni tshad ma nyid ma yin// mi mthong 'dzin na long ba la// sogs pa yis kyang don mthong 'gyur// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa lan ni/ nyes pa de dag gis mi gnod de/ gzugs 'dzin yid mngon de rang gi de ma thag rkyen dbang mngon gyis ma bzung ba'i don 'dzin pas tshad ma ma yin par yang mi 'gyur la/ dbang mngon la ma brten par gzugs mthong ba med pas long bas gzugs mthong bar thal ba'i skyon yang med pa'i phyir te/ yid ni yul gzhan nyid 'dzin byed// de phyir long bas mthong ba min/ /zhes dang*/ rigs gter las/ yul gzhan 'dzin dang dbang po la// ltos phyir 'di la skyon gnyis med// ces bshad pa'i phyir/ lnga pa bdag rkyen ngos bzung ba ni/ tshad ma'i gzhung las yid mngon gyi bdag rkyen ma gsungs shing*/ bdag rkyen gyi rnam gzhag ni mngon pa las byung ba yin la/ mngon pa las khams bco brgyad du bshad pa'i dgos pa ni/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i bdag rkyen sgrub pa'i ched du yin zhing*/ bdag rkyen gyi mtshan gzhi yang rnam par shes pa'i tshogs drug po 'das ma thag pa de nyid yin te/ drug po 'das ma thag pa yi// rnam shes gang yin de yid do/ /zhes dang*/ tha ma'i rten 'das/ zhes 'chad pa'i phyir/ des na gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma dang po 'das ma thag pa de/ gzugs 'dzin yid mngon skad cig ma dang po'i bdag rkyen dang*/ de bzhin du sgra 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma dang po 'das ma thag pa de/ sgra 'dzin yid mngon skad cig ma dang po'i bdag rkyen yin pa nas/ reg 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma dang po 'das ma thag pa de/ reg 'dzin yid mngon skad cig ma dang po'i bdag rkyen yin pa'i bar du khas len pa yin no// gsum pa rang rig mngon sum bshad pa la/ rang rig de la rang rig tsam dang*/ mngon sum bzhis zlas phye ba'i rang rig mngon sum gnyis su yod/ dang po ni/ tshad ma dang tshad min gyi shes pa thams cad la byed pa yin te/

tshad ma mdor/ chags la sogs// rang rig rtog pa med pa can/ /zhes dang*/ rtog pa'ang rang rig nyid du 'dod// don la ma yin der rtog phyir/ /zhes dang*/ rnam 'grel las/ shes gang gang la sgra don 'dzin// de ni de la rtog pa yin// rang gi ngo bo sgra don min// de phyir de la kun mngon sum/ /zhes dang*/ rigs gter las/ rang gi ngo bo rig pa ni// mngon sum yin par mkhas rnams bzhed// ces bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mngon sum bzhis zlas phye ba'i rang rig mngon sum ni/ bod snga rabs pa rnams kyis shes pa thams cad kyi steng nas yul gyi kha ma bsgyur ba'i gsal rig gi cha re re yod par bshad pa de nyid/ mdo sde pa ltar na/ mngon sum bzhis zlas phye ba'i rang rig mngon sum dang*/ sems tsam rnam bden pa ltar na/ gzung rnam nyams su myong ba'i rang rig mngon sum dang*/ rnam rdzun pa ltar na/ 'dzin rnam khyad par gsum ldan zhes bya ba yin no// 'o na shes pa rang gis rang rig pa yin na rang las rang skye ba yod par 'gyur ro zhe na/ de'i skyon med de/ rang rig ni bems po las ldog tsam la byed pa yin la/ rang skye ni rang las rang sngon med gsar du skye ba zhig la byed pa'i phyir te/ tshad ma rgyan las/ bems min rang bzhin gang yin pa// de 'dir bdag nyid rig pa yin/ /zhes dang*/ rigs gter las/ rang rig bems po ldog tsam yin// sngar skye sngon med skye ba yin// des na rang rig rang skye gnyis// mtshungs pa'i go skabs ga la yod// ces bshad pa'i phyir/ shes pa thams cad rang gis rang rig pa yin te/ de lta ma yin par rig byed gzhan la ltos dgos na rig byed thug med du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ 'o na shes pa thams cad tshad ma yin par 'gyur te/ rang gi ngo bo la tshad ma yin pa'i phyir te/ rang gi ngo bo rang rig mngon sum yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ de'i skyon med de/ tshad ma yin min ni 'jug yul la ltos nas 'jog dgos pa'i phyir te/

rnam 'grel las/ blang dang dor bya'i dngos po ni// 'jug la de gtso yin phyir dang*/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa rnal 'byor mngon sum la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ bden bzhi mi rtag sogs bcu drug sgoms pa la brten nas bdag med mngon sum du mthong ba'i rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i rig pa de/ rnal 'byor mngon sum gyi mtshan nyid yin te/ tshad ma mdor/ rnal 'byor rnams kyi bla mas bstan// ma 'dres pa yi don tsam mthong*/ /zhes dang*/ rnam 'grel las/ rnal 'byor shes pa sngar bshad pa// de dag gi de sgom byung yin/ /zhes dang*/ rigs gter las/ sgom byung 'khrul med mngon sum mo// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ snang bcas rnal 'byor mngon sum dang*/ snang med rnal 'byor mngon sum gnyis yod/ dang po snang bcas rnal 'byor mngon sum la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rnal 'byor mngon sum gang zhig /kun rdzob rten 'brel sna tshogs su snang ba de/ snang bcas rnal 'byor mngon sum gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ 'phags pa gsum gyi snang bcas rnal 'byor mngon sum gsum du yod/ 'o na rten 'brel sna tshogs su snang ba'i mngon sum thams cad snang bcas rnal 'byor mngon sum du khas len par nus sam zhe na/ de la bdag rkyen tha mal pa'i dbang yid la brten nas snang ba dang*/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi ting nge 'dzin la brten nas snang ba gnyis su yod pa las/ dang po ni/ dbang yid kyi mngon sum du khas len par byed cing*/ gnyis pa ni/ snang bcas rnal 'byor mngon sum du khas len pa yin no// de yang zhib tu byas na 'phags pa gsum gyi rjes thob tu rten 'brel sna tshogs su snang ba thams cad gang zag dang chos kyi bdag med par rtogs pa'i ye shes zhig la snang bcas rnal 'byor mngon sum du byed pa yin no// gnyis pa snang med rnal 'byor mngon sum la/ mtshan nyid dang*/

dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rnal 'byor mngon sum gang zhig /kun rdzob bden pa'i snang ba dang bral ba de/ snang med rnal 'byor mngon sum gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ gang zag gi bdag med pa dang*/ gzung ba chos kyi bdag med pa dang*/ 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med par rtogs pa'i snang med rnal 'byor mngon sum dang gsum du yod/ rigs gter ba ltar na/ rnal 'byor mngon sum de la nyan thos slob mi slob gnyis/ rang rgyal mi slob pa/ theg chen slob mi slob kyi rnal 'byor mngon sum lnga/ de re re la snang bcas snang med gnyis gnyis su phye bas bcur yod de/ rigs gter las/ 'phags pa gsum gyi mngon sum gsum// slob dang mi slob sgo nas lnga// de dag snang bcas snang med kyi// dbye bas gnyis gnyis rnam pa bcu// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mngon sum ltar snang la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'khrul pa'i shes pa de/ mngon sum ltar snang gi mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ tshad ma kun las btus ltar na/ rtog pa mngon sum ltar snang drug /rtog med mngon sum ltar snang gcig dang bdun du yod de/ kun las btus las/ 'khrul dang kun rdzob shes pa dang*// rjes dpag rjes su dpag las byung*// dran dang mngon 'dod ces bya ba// mngon sum ltar snang rab rib bcas// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ dang po rtog pa mngon sum ltar snang drug ni/ smig sgyu la chur 'dzin gyi rtog pa lta bu 'khrul pa'i shes pa dang*/ bye brag pas 'dod pa'i dngos po tshig gi don drug 'dzin pa'i rtog pa lta bu kun rdzob pa'i shes pa dang*/ rtags 'dzin sems dang*/ rtags can rjes dpag dang*/ dran pa dang*/ mngon par 'dod pa dang drug la byed pa yin no// bye brag pas 'dod pa'i dngos po tshig gi don drug ni/ rdzas dang yon tan las dang spyi// bye brag 'du ba rnam pa drug/ ces bshad pa ltar ro/ /rtog med mngon sum ltar snang gcig

ni/ rab rib can skra shad du snang ba'i shes pa lta bu la byed/ rnam 'grel ltar na/ mngon sum ltar snang de la rtog pa mngon sum ltar snang gsum/ rtog med mngon sum ltar snang gcig dang bzhir yod de/ mngon sum ltar snang rnam pa bzhi// rtog pa'i shes pa rnam gsum dang*// rten bslad pa las byung ba can// rtog pa med pa gcig yin no// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ dang po rtog pa mngon sum ltar snang gsum ni/ don gzhan la sgro 'dogs pa'i rtog pa/ brda rten can gyi rtog pa/ lkog tu gyur pa'i don can gyi rtog pa dang gsum la byed/ rtog med mngon sum ltar snang gcig ni/ dung ser snang can gyi dbang shes lta bu la byed/ yang na/ mngon sum ltar snang thams cad rtog pa dang rtog med gnyis su 'dus pa yin te/ rnam 'grel las/ bslu ba'i phyir ro de don du'ang*// mngon sum ltar snang gnyis su bshad// ces bshad pa'i phyir/ mdo las rtog pa drug tu bshad pa dang*/ rnam 'grel las rtog pa gsum du bshad pa'i dgos pa ni/ rigs gter las/ rtog pa gsum yin drug bshad pa// log rtog bzlog phyir phye ste bshad// ces bshad pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa mngon sum tshad ma'i 'bras bu sgrub byed dang bcas te bshad pa la/ tshad 'bras gzhal gsum gyi rnam gzhag dngos dang*/ rnam gzhag de nyid nges par byed pa gnyis las/ dang po la/ 'o na gong du tshad ma'i mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ grangs nges sogs bshad na/ tshad ma de rgyud la skyes pa'i dgos pa'am 'bras bu gang yin zhe na/ de la 'jug yul la mi bslu ba dang*/ gzhal bya rtogs pa gnyis yod pa las/ dang po'i sgrub byed ni/ tshad ma bslu med can shes pa/ /zhes sogs dang*/ dngos gang ji lta bur gyur pa/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan la/ gnyis pa'i sgrub byed 'dir 'chad pa skabs su bab pa yin la/ de la yang tshad 'bras gzhal gsum gyi rnam gzhag spyir bshad pa dang*/ skabs su bab pa'i don so sor bshad pa gnyis/

dang po ni/ tshad 'bras gzhal gsum dang bya byed las gsum don gcig pa yin te/ bya ba ni 'bras bu dang*/ byed pa ni tshad ma dang*/ las ni gzhal bya yin pa'i phyir/ 'bras bu de yang gnyis kho na yin te/ don rig 'bras bur byas pa dang rang rig 'bras bur byas pa gnyis su 'dus pa'i phyir/ tshad ma yang gnyis kho na yin te/ gzung rnam tshad mar byas pa dang*/ 'dzin rnam tshad mar byas pa gnyis su 'dus pa'i phyir/ gzhal bya dang 'bras bu la ni log par rtog pa cher ma byung zhing*/ tshad ma la ni log par rtog pa du ma zhig byung ste/ spyod pa bas/ dang por don mthong ba'i rtog med kyi shes pa tshad ma dang*/ rgyal dpog pas/ dbang po gzugs can pa tshad ma dang*/ bye brag pas/ dbang don 'brel ba tshad ma dang*/ rigs pa can pas/ spyi sogs khyad par gyi blo tshad mar 'dod pa'i phyir te/ de phyir mthong dang dbang 'brel dang*// khyad par gyi ni blo de dag/ bya ba la ni chod pa'i phyir// tshad ma nyid du mi 'dod do/ /zhes dang*/ rigs gter las/ lta dang nges pa tshad 'bras 'dod// zhes sogs bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa skabs su bab pa'i don so sor bshad pa la/ grub mtha' smra ba so so'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag ngos bzung ba dang*/ de nyid gzhung gis ji ltar bstan pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ rigs pas ma brtags ma dpyad pa 'jig rten grags pa dang mthun pa'i tshad 'bras/ rigs pas cung zad dpyad pa'i tshad 'bras/ rigs pas shin tu dpyad pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag dang gsum/ dang po rigs pas ma brtags ma dpyad pa 'jig rten grags pa dang mthun pa'i tshad 'bras ni/ phyi don gzhal bya/ don dang 'dra bar skyes pa'i shes pa tshad ma/ don rtogs pa 'bras bur byas pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa rigs pas cung zad dpyad pa'i tshad 'bras ni/ phyi rol gyi don gzhal bya/ gzung rnam tshad ma/ rang rig 'bras bur byas pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag lta bu la byed/

gsum pa rigs pas shin tu dpyad pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag la/ gzung rnam gzhal bya/ 'dzin rnam tshad ma/ rang rig 'bras bur byas pa'i tshad 'bras gcig dang*/ gzung 'dzin gnyis bral gyi shes pa gzhal bya/ de 'jal ba'i 'dzin rnam tshad ma/ rang rig 'bras bur byas pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag gcig dang gnyis su yod pa yin no// tshad 'bras dang po de ni mdo sems gnyis kas thun mong du khas len pa dang*/ tshad 'bras gnyis pa de ni rigs pas dpyad pa'i mdo sde pas khas len pa dang*/ tshad 'bras gsum pa de ni sems tsam rnam bden pas khas len pa dang*/ tshad 'bras bzhi pa de ni rnam rdzun smra ba'i dbu ma pas khas len par byed pa yin no// gnyis pa de nyid gzhung gis ji ltar bstan pa'i tshul ni/ tshad 'bras dang po ni/ mdo las/ bya dang bcas par rtogs pa'i phyir/ /zhes sogs dang*/ rnam 'grel las/ bya ba sgrub par byed ces te/ /zhes pa nas/ sgro 'dogs pa ni 'jug phyir ro/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ tshad 'bras gnyis pa ni/ mdo las/ yang na rang rig 'dir 'bras bu/ /zhes dang*/ gang tshe phyi rol don gzhal bya/ /zhes sogs dang*/ rnam 'grel las/ don rig gang yin/ /zhes pa nas/ don rig par ni 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan pa dang*/ tshad 'bras gsum pa dang bzhi pa gnyis ni/ mdo las/

gang tshe rnam pa de gzhal bya// tshad ma dang de'i 'bras bu ni// 'dzin rnam rig pa'o de'i phyir// de gsum tha dad du ma byas/ /zhes pas bstan zhing*/ rnam 'grel las ni/ gzung ba 'dzin pa rig pa dag/ yod pa min yang gzhal bya dang*// 'jal byed 'bras bu gnas pa ni// ji ltar rjes su snang bzhin byas// zhes pas tshad 'bras gsum pa de bstan pa dang*/ de la blo ni yongs gcod pa// 'dzin pa'i rnam par 'dod pa ste// de yi bdag nyid phyir bdag rig/ de phyir de yi sgrub byed yin// zhes pas tshad 'bras bzhi pa de bstan pa yin no/ /'dir gzung rnam ni/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang can gyi shes pa la byed/ 'dzin rnam ni de'i steng gi yul gyis kha ma bsgyur ba'i gsal rig gi cha lta bu la byed/ rang rig ni shes pa rang gis rang nyid nyams su myong ba lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa rnam gzhag de nyid nges par byed pa la/ tshad ma la ltos nas blo tshul gnyis su sgrub pa dang*/ 'bras bu la ltos nas blo rang rig tu sgrub pa gnyis su yod/ gsum pa lkog gyur gtan la 'bebs byed rjes dpag bshad pa la/ yang dag dang*/ ltar snang gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba/ rjes dpag gi tshad 'bras bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ tshul gsum tshang ba'i rtags la brten nas gzhal bya gsar du rtogs shing 'jug yul la gsar du mi bslu ba'i rig pa de rjes dpag gi mtshan nyid yin te/ mdo las/ rjes dpag rnam gnyis rang don ni// tshul gsum rtags las don mthong ba'o/ /zhes dang*/ rnam 'grel las/ med na mi 'byung mtshan nyid can// rtags ni rjes dpag rten yin no// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ dngos po stobs zhugs kyi rjes dpag grags pa'i rjes dpag yid ches pa'i rjes dpag dang gsum du yod/ gsum pa tshad 'bras la/ don rig gi tshad 'bras dang*/ rang rig gi tshad 'bras gnyis/ dang po ni/ sgra mi rtag pa gzhal bya/ byas pa'i rtags las sgra mi rtag par rtogs pa'i rjes dpag tshad ma/

sgra mi rtag par rtogs pa 'bras bur byas pa'i tshad 'bras lta bu/ gnyis pa rang rig gi tshad 'bras ni/ byas pa'i rtags las sgra mi rtag par rtogs pa'i rjes dpag gzhal bya/ de 'jal ba'i 'dzin rnam tshad ma/ rang rig 'bras bur byas pa'i tshad 'bras lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa rjes dpag ltar snang la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ tshul gsum ma tshang ba'i rtags la brten pa'i blo de/ rjes dpag ltar snang gi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ 'gal/ ma nges/ ma grub pa'i rtags la brten pa gsum du yod/ gnyis pa tshad ma des shes bya gtan la 'bebs pa'i tshul la*/ shes bya'i yul dang*/ shes byed kyi blo dang*/ blo des ji ltar rtogs pa'i tshul dang gsum du yod/ dang po la/ yul/ shes bya/ gzhal bya dang gsum du yod/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ blos rig par bya ba de'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ snang yul/ zhen yul/ gzung yul/ 'jug yul dang bzhir yod/ dang po gnyis ni/ bod kyi slob dpon rnams kyis rtog pas btags pa yin no/ /gzhung las bshad pa ni phyi ma gnyis yin zhing*/ dang po snang yul la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ snang nas rig par bya ba de'o/ /gnyis pa la/ rtog pa'i snang yul dang*/ rtog med shes pa'i snang yul gnyis su yod/ gnyis pa zhen yul la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ zhen nas rig par bya ba de'o/ /gnyis pa la/ rjod byed kyi sgra'i zhen yul dang*/ rtog pa'i zhen yul gnyis su yod/ gsum pa gzung yul la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang 'dzin shes pa ma 'khrul ba la rang 'dra'i rnam pa gtod par byed pa de de'i mtshan nyid yin te/ shes pa'i rnam pa 'jog nus pa'i// rgyu nyid la ni gzung ba shes// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ phyi don rang mtshan rnams so// bzhi pa 'jug yul la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ blang dor bya ba'i phyir zhugs pa na mi bslu ba'i don byed nus pa de'o/

/gnyis pa mtshan gzhi la/ yul gyi mi bslu ba dang*/ yul can gyi mi bslu ba gnyis su yod/ gzung yul dang 'jug yul gnyis la rang mtshan gyis khyab ste/ gzung yul yin na phyi rol don du gyur pa'i rang mtshan yin pas khyab cing*/ 'jug yul yin na yang rang mtshan yin dgos pa'i phyir te/ rang gi mtshan nyid gcig gzhal bya// yod med nyid du dpyod rnams kyis// don cha de las grub phyir ro/ /zhes dang*/ tshad ma gnyis ka dngos po yi// yul can/ zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ bod phyi ma phal cher/ snang yul shes pa thams cad la yod par 'chad la/ rigs gter ba ltar na/ rang rig mngon sum la snang yul med cing*/ spyir yang snang yul mtshan nyid pa med de/ snang ba mtshan nyid pa yin na yul btags pa ba dang*/ yul mtshan nyid pa yin na snang ba btags pa ba yin dgos pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs la/ des na de gnyis la mu bzhir yod de/ snang ba mtshan nyid pa yin la yul btags pa ba yin pa ni/ bum 'dzin rtog pa la bum par snang ba dang*/ yul mtshan nyid pa yin la snang ba btags pa ba yin pa ni/ sngor snang dbang shes kyi lta bu'o/ /gnyis ka ma yin pa ni/ shes pa de nyid lta bu'o/ /zhen yul ni rtog med kyi shes pa la mi srid de/ de yin na spyi mtshan yin dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa shes bya la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ blo'i yul du byar rung de'o/ /gnyis pa la/ kun btags/ gzhan dbang*/ yongs grub dang gsum du yod/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi ngo bo med bzhin du gzung 'dzin gang rung du snang ba la gzung 'dzin gang rung du sgro btags pa'i cha de'o/ /gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ bdag dang phyi rol gyi don lta bu'o// gnyis pa gzhan dbang la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ bag chags kyi dbang gis khams gsum gang rung gi rnam pa can du snang ba'i shes pa de'o/ /gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ rnam par shes pa'i tshogs bdun 'khor dang bcas pa'o/

/kun gzhi ni gzhan dbang du mi bzhag ste/ de'i mtshan nyid la ma tshang ba'i phyir dang*/ shes bya'i gnas dang mtshan nyid der 'jug dang*/ /zhes gsungs pas mtshan nyid gsum ka'i gnas su bshad pa'i phyir ro/ / gsum pa yongs grub la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzung 'dzin gnyis kyis stong pa'i de kho na nyid de'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ 'gyur med yongs grub dang*/ phyin ci ma log pa'i yongs grub gnyis su yod/ dang po ni/ gzung 'dzin gnyis stong gi sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes lta bu'o/ /yang na/ shes bya la dbye na/ phung khams skye mched gsum du yod/ gsum pa gzhal bya la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ tshad mas rtogs par bya ba de'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ 'jug tshul gyi sgo nas phye na/ rang spyi gnyis/ rtogs dka' sla'i sgo nas phye na/ mngon lkog gnyis/ yul can gyi sgo nas phye na/ bden pa gnyis so// dang po rang mtshan la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ yul dus rang bzhin ma 'dres par gnas pa'i dngos po de'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ skad cig cha med kyi shes pa dang*/ phyogs kyi cha med kyi rdul phra rab lta bu'o// gnyis pa spyi mtshan la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ yul dus thun mong du rjes 'gro byed pa'i chos so/ /gnyis pa ni/ ldog pa dang gzhan sel rnams so/ /der ma zad dpyad pa'i tshe rags rgyun gyi dngos po rnams kyang spyi mtshan du 'chad dgos so/ /de'i tshe spyi yin na spyi mtshan yin pas khyab kyang*/ spyi mtshan yin na spyi dang gzhan sel yin pas ma khyab ste/ rags rgyun gyi dngos po rnams so/ /des na spyi mtshan la rigs spyi dang*/ tshogs spyi gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ldog pa gzhan sel dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ rags pa dang rgyun gyi dngos po rnams la byed do//

dbye sgo gnyis pa'i mngon gyur la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ mngon sum gyi tshad mas rtogs par bya ba de/ mngon gyur gyi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ mdo sde pa dang po ltar na don mngon 'gyur dang*/ shes pa mngon gyur gnyis su yod/ mdo sde pa gnyis pa dang sems tsam pa ltar na/ mngon gyur yin na shes pa yin pas khyab pa yin no// gnyis pa lkog gyur la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rjes su dpag pa'i tshad mas rtogs par bya ba de/ gzhal bya lkog gyur gyi mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ don lkog gyur dang*/ tha snyad lkog gyur gnyis su yod/ dang po la yang*/ cung zad lkog gyur dang*/ shin tu lkog gyur gnyis su yod/ gnyis pa tha snyad lkog gyur ni/ ming lta bu'o// zhar la 'jug yul mngon lkog gi mtshan nyid ni/ rang 'jug yul du byed pa'i tshad ma de khyod la mngon sum gyi tshad mar song ba de/ khyod 'jug yul mngon gyur yin pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ don rang mtshan dang*/ shes pa rang mtshan gnyis su yod/ rang 'jug yul du byed pa'i tshad ma de khyod la rjes su dpag pa'i tshad mar song ba de/ khyod 'jug yul lkog gyur yin pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sgra mi rtag pa rang mtshan dang*/ la dang me'i tshogs don rang mtshan lta bu'o// dbye sgo gsum pa'i don dam bden pa la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ don dam par don byed nus pa de'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang mtshan rnams so/ /gnyis pa kun rdzob bden pa la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ don dam par don byed mi nus pa'i chos so/ gnyis pa ni/ spyi mtshan rnams so// gnyis pa shes byed kyi blo la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ bod phyi ma rnams/ yul rig pa blo'i mtshan nyid yin/ zhes zer ba mi 'thad de/ yul dang blo gnyis rtogs pa phan tshun brten par thal ba dang*/ rang rig mngon sum dang 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes rnams la rang las gzhan pa'i yul rig rgyu med pa'i phyir/

rang gi lugs ni/ yul 'dzin nus kyi rig pa de'o// gnyis pa dbye ba la/ tshad min gyi blo dang*/ tshad ma'i blo gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ tshad ma ma yin pa'i rig pa de'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ slob dpon phya pa ltar na/ yid dpyod dang*/ snang la ma nges pa dang*/ bcad shes dang*/ log shes dang*/ the tshom dang lngar yod de/ rigs gter las/ yid dpyod snang la ma nges pa// bcad shes log shes the tshom lnga// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ rigs gter ba ltar na/ ma rtogs log rtog the tshom gsum du yod de/ ma rtogs log rtog the tshom gsum// tshad ma'i 'gal zla rnam pa gsum/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa tshad ma bshad zin to/ /zhar la shes pa la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ gsal zhing rig pa de'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ rnam shes dang*/ ye shes gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ bag chags kyi dbang gis gzung 'dzin gnyis su snang ba'i rig pa'am rig pa de'i rten du gyur pa gang rung gi rig pa de'o/ /gnyis pa la/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi rig pa dngos dang*/ de'i gnas su gyur pa gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ kun gzhi'i steng gi bag chags yongs su smin pa las byung ba'i gzung 'dzin gnyis snang can gyi rig pa'o// gnyis pa dbye ba la/ gtso bo sems dang*/ 'khor sems byung gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ bag chags kyi dbang gis don gyi ngo bo tsam mthong ba'i rnam par rig pa de'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ yid dang*/ 'dzin pa dang*/ rnam par rtog pa dang gsum du yod/ dang po ni/ gnyid dang*/ gnyis pa 'dzin pa ni/ sgo lnga'i shes pa dang*/ gsum pa rnam par rtog pa ni/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa'o// gnyis pa sems byung la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ bag chags kyi dbang gis don gyi ngo bo la dmigs nas khyad par 'dzin stangs kyi yul du byed pa'i rig pa de'o/

/gnyis pa dbye ba la/ lnga bcu rtsa gcig tu yod do// gnyis pa de'i gnas su 'gyur ba'i rig pa ni/ kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa la byed/ kun gzhi dang nyon yid gnyis ni/ gtso bo'i sems mtshan nyid pa ma yin te/ don gyi ngo bo tsam mthong ba ma yin pa'i phyir/ de gnyis kyi 'khor gyi sems byung rnams kyang sems byung mtshan nyid pa ma yin no/ /kun gzhi'i steng gi zag med kyi sa bon ni/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes dngos ma yin te/ de'i gnyen po yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ye shes la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ ma rig pa'i bslad pa dang bral ba'i zag pa med pa'i shes pa de'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ rgyu/ lam/ 'bras bu'i ye shes dang gsum yod/ gsum pa blo des yul ji ltar rtogs pa'i tshul la/ spyi dang bye brag gi rtogs tshul/ snang ba dang sel ba'i rtogs tshul/ dgag pa dang sgrub pa'i rtogs tshul/ brjod bya dang rjod byed kyi rtogs tshul/ 'gal ba dang 'brel ba'i rtogs tshul/ mtshan nyid dang mtshon bya'i rtogs tshul dang drug tu yod/ dang po la/ gzhan lugs mi 'thad pa dang*/ rang lugs bzhag pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bye brag pas/ spyi bye brag rdzas tha dad dang*/ spyi la yang yod pa nyid ces pa'i spyi chen po dang*/ ba lang nyid ces bya ba'i nyi tshe ba'i spyi gnyis su 'dod cing*/ spyi bsal gnyis la 'phrod 'du'i 'brel ba grub par 'dod/ grangs can pa ni/ spyi bye brag rdzas gcig tu 'dod cing*/ bod phyi ma phal che ba yang*/ dngos po gzhir byas kyi spyi dang bye brag rdzas gcig pa yin no zhes zer/ de dag mi 'thad par 'god pa ni/ rigs gter las/ tha dad spyir 'dod 'ug phrug pa// rdzas gcig yin zhes grangs can pa// gangs can pa rnams der rjes 'brang*// sel bar 'dod pa mkhas pa'i lugs// zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa rang lugs la/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis las/ dang po la/ spyi bye brag gis zlas phye ba'i spyi dang*/

spyi bsal gnyis kyis zlas phye ba'i spyi gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ sel ngor rigs mi mthun las log pa'i ldog pa chig rkyang de'o/ /gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ sel ngor bum pa ma yin pa rnam par bsal tsam de'o/ /yang*/ kho bum pa'i spyi yin na bum pa kho'i bye brag yin pas ma khyab ste/ sel ngor bum pa ma yin pa rnam par bsal tsam de bum pa'i spyi yin kyang*/ bum pa de'i bye brag ma yin pa'i phyir/ yang*/ kho de'i bye brag yin na de kho'i spyi yin pas khyab pa yin no// gnyis pa spyi bsal gnyis kyis zlas phye ba'i spyi ni/ spyi bsal gnyis kyis zlas phye ba'i spyi dang*/ ldog pa/ gzhan sel rnams don gcig cing*/ de gnyis kyis zlas phye ba'i bsal ba dang*/ log pa/ rang mtshan rnams don gcig pa yin no// gnyis pa bye brag la/ mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ sel ngor rigs mi mthun las kyang log rigs mthun nang las kyang log pa'i ldog pa gnyis tshogs de/ spyi bye brag gnyis kyis zlas phye ba'i bye brag dang*/ gzhi mthun gnyis ka'i mtshan nyid yin te/

mthun dngos gzhan gyi dngos dag las// ldog pa la ni brten pa can// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ sel ngor bum pa ma yin pa rnam par bsal tsam lta bu la byed/ dbye sgo gnyis pa snang ba dang sel ba'i rtogs tshul la/ yul snang ba dang sel ba bshad pa dang*/ yul can snang 'jug dang sel 'jug bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ snang ba dang*/ sel ba gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang 'dzin rtog med kyi shes pas snang ba'i sgo nas rtogs par bya ba'i chos so/ /gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ don rang mtshan dang shes pa rang mtshan rnams la byed/ gnyis pa sel ba la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi yul can gyi sgra dang rtog pa don mthun gyis log phyogs rnams bsal ba'i tshul gyis yul du byed pa'i blo chos so/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ rang gi mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas dbye ba/ rten gyi sgo nas dbye ba/ yul can gyi sgo nas dbye ba dang gsum du yod/ dang po la/ yod pa gzhan sel dang*/ med pa gzhan sel gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi yul can gyi sgra dang rtog pas don byed mi nus pa rnam par bsal tsam gyis yul du byed pa'i blo chos so/ /gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ sel ngor bum pa ma yin pa rnam par bsal tsam de/ bum pa'i gzhan sel yin pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa med pa gzhan sel la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi yul can gyi sgra dang rtog pas don byed nus pa rnam par bsal ba'i tshul gyis yul du byed pa'i blo chos so/ /gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ shes bya'i gzhan sel lta bu la byed do/ /yang na/ dgag bya shes bya la srid pa'i gzhan sel dang*/ de mi srid pa'i gzhan sel gnyis su yod/ dang po ni/ bum pa'i gzhan sel lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bdag gnyis kyi gzhan sel lta bu'o// gnyis pa rten gyi sgo nas dbye ba la/ dngos po la brten pa'i gzhan sel/

dngos med la brten pa'i gzhan sel/ gnyis ka la brten pa'i gzhan sel gsum du yod/ dang po ni/ bum pa'i ldog pa dang*/ gnyis pa dngos med la brten pa'i gzhan sel ni/ nam mkha'i ldog pa dang*/ gsum pa gnyis ka la brten pa'i gzhan sel ni/ shes bya dang gzhal bya'i ldog pa lta bu'o// dbye sgo gsum pa yul can gyi sgo nas dbye ba la/ sgra'i gzhan sel dang*/ blo'i gzhan sel gnyis su yod/ dang po ni/ bum pa zhes brjod pa'i sgras bum pa ma yin pa rnam par bsal tsam lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa blo'i gzhan sel ni/ bum 'dzin rtog pa la bum par snang ba la bum par sgro btags pa'i cha lta bu'o/ /gzhan sel gyi ming gi rnam grangs la/ ldog pa zhes bya zhing*/ de la rang ldog gzhan ldog don ldog gsum du yod/ gnyis pa yul can snang 'jug dang sel 'jug bshad pa la/ bod phyi ma dag rang yul la cha shas su ma phye bar 'jug pa snang 'jug dang*/ de phye nas 'jug pa sel 'jug tu bshad/ rang lugs ni/ rang gi shes bya gsal bar snang ba'i rtog med kyi shes pa de/ snang 'jug gi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ snang 'jug 'khrul pa dang*/ ma 'khrul ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ zla ba gnyis snang gi dbang shes lta bu dang*/ gnyis pa snang 'jug ma 'khrul ba ni/ mngon sum rnams la byed/ rang yul gyi log phyogs rnam par bsal ba'i tshul gyis 'jug pa'i yul can de/ sel 'jug gi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ rjod byed kyi sgra dang*/ rtog pa gnyis su yod/ de re re la yang phyin ci log ma log gnyis gnyis su yod/ dang po ni/ sgra rtag ces brjod pa'i sgra dang*/ sgra rtag 'dzin gyi rtog pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ sgra mi rtag ces brjod pa'i sgra dang*/ sgra mi rtag par 'dzin pa'i rtog pa lta bu la byed/ gsum pa dgag pa dang sgrub pa'i rtogs tshul la/ dgag pa dang*/ sgrub pa gnyis las/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/

rang dngos yul du byed pa'i sgra dang rtog pas rnam bcad du rtogs par bya ba'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ dgag pa rkyang pa dang*/ dgag sgrub gnyis tshogs pa'o/ /yang na/ dgag pa de la/ ma yin dgag dang*/ med dgag gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ dgag pa gang zhig /rang ming gis dgag bya bkag shul du chos gzhan 'phen pa'o/ /gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ lhas sbyin tshon po nyin par zan mi za ba rid pa ma yin pa yod pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa med dgag la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ dgag pa gang zhig /rang tshig zin la brjod pa'i sgras rang gi dgag bya bkag shul du chos gzhan mi 'phen pa de'o/ /gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ bdag med dang dngos med lta bu'o// gnyis pa sgrub pa la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi yul can gyi blos yongs gcod du rtogs par bya ba'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ snang ba'i sgrub pa dang*/ sel ba'i sgrub pa gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi yul can gyi rtog med kyi shes pas yongs gcod du rtogs par bya ba de'o/ /gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ don rang mtshan rnams la byed/ 'dis sel 'jug dang sgrub 'jug gnyis kyis zlas phye ba'i sgrub pa'i go chod kyang dgag sgrub gnyis kyis zlas phye ba'i sgrub pa'i go mi chod de/ chod na rang mtshan dgag sgrub kyi dngos rten du rung bar thal ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa sel ba'i sgrub pa la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang dngos yul du byed pa'i rtog pas yongs gcod du rtogs par bya ba de'o/ /gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ ma yin dgag rnams so/ /'dis sgrub 'jug dang sel 'jug gi rnam bzhag byed pa'i sgrub pa'i go mi chod kyang*/ dgag sgrub gnyis kyis zlas phye ba'i sgrub pa'i go chod pa yin no// bzhi pa brjod bya dang rjod byed kyi rtogs tshul la gnyis las/

dang po brjod bya la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ brda las go bar bya ba de'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ 'chad tshe rnam par phye ba'i dbang du byas pa dang*/ 'jug tshe gcig tu 'khrul ba'i dbang du byas pa'i brjod bya gnyis su yod/ dang po ltar na/ brjod bya de la sgra'i zhen pa'i brjod bya/ sgra'i dngos kyi brjod bya gnyis su yod cing*/ dang po la rang mtshan gyis khyab pa dang*/ gnyis pa la spyi mtshan gyis khyab pa yin te/ brjod bya nyid phyir de dngos min/ /zhes dang*/ de tshe rang gi mtshan nyid med/ /des na de la brdar ma yin/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'jug tshe gcig tu 'khrul ba'i dbang du byas pa'i brjod bya ltar na/ rlom song so sor ma phye ba'i tshogs don la brda sbyor ba yin te/ dper na chu len pa'i bya ba la 'jug pa na bum pa 'on cig ces brjod pa yin gyi/ rang mtshan gyi bum pa'am gzhan sel gyi bum pa 'on cig ces mi brjod pa bzhin no// gnyis pa rjod byed la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ don go bar byed pa'i brda de'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ song tshod kyi rjod byed dang*/ rloms tshod kyi rjod byed gnyis/ brjod tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ chos brjod pa'i sgra dang*/ chos can brjod pa'i sgra gnyis/ don ston tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ ming*/ tshig yi ge gsum du yod/ dang po ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba la gnyis kyi/ dang po song tshod kyi rjod byed la mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi gdags gzhi yi ge du ma 'dus pa la btags pa'i sgra spyi bsal ba'o/ /gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ bum pa zhes brjod pa'i tshe rtog pa la ming du snang ba'i ldan pa ma yin pa'i 'du byed do/ /gnyis pa rloms tshod kyi rjod byed la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi gdags gzhi yi ge du ma 'dus pa la btags pa'i sgra rang mtshan du rlom pa'i cha de'o/

/gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ bum pa zhes brjod pa'i sgra nyan shes la snang ba de nyid do// gnyis pa brjod tshul gyi sgo nas dbye ba la/ chos brjod pa'i sgra dang*/ chos can brjod pa'i sgra gnyis kyi/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ ldog pa brjod pa'i sgra gang zhig /rang gi chos can brjod byar mi spong zhing chos can de'i ldog pa'i khyad par gzhan thams cad spong ba'i sgra de'o/ /gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ sgra'i mi rtag ces brjod pa'am mi rtag pa nyid ces brjod pa'i sgra lta bu'o// gnyis pa chos can brjod pa'i sgra la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ log pa brjod pa'i sgra gang zhig /rang gi chos can brjod byar mi spong zhing chos can de'i ldog pa'i khyad par gzhan mi spong ba'i sgra de'o/ /gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ sgra mi rtag pa zhes brjod pa'am mi rtag pa zhes brjod pa'i sgra lta bu'o// yang na/ chos can brjod pa'i sgra de la bum pa zhes brjod pa'i sgra lta bu log pa brjod pa'i sgra dang*/ nam mkha' zhes pa lta bu bsgrub bya'i chos can brjod pa'i sgra gnyis su yod/ ldog pa'i khyad par sna tshogs pa de/ chos chos can gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i chos kyi mtshan nyid/ de la ldog pa dang*/ spyi mtshan dang*/ gzhan sel gyis khyab pa yin no/ /ldog pa du ma'i rten gzhir gyur pa de/ de gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i chos can gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la ni bsal ba dang*/ log pa dang*/ rang mtshan gyis khyab pa yin no// gsum pa don ston tshul gyi sgo nas dbye ba la/ ming tshig yi ge gsum gyi dang po la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi gdags gzhi yi ge du ma 'dus nas don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i rjod byed de'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ thog ma nyid du sgrub pa'i ming dang*/ rjes su grub pa'i ming gnyis su yod de/ smra sgo las/ de yang ming gi thog ma dang*// rjes su grub pa rnam pa gnyis//

zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ dang po thog ma nyid du sgrub pa'i ming la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyu mtshan dang dgos pa la ma ltos par 'dod rgyal thog mar brda sbyar ba'i ming de'o/ /gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ bram ze'i khye'u la seng ge zhes brjod pa lta bu'o/ /'dod rgyal thog ma'i ming yin na sgra bshad med pas khyab ste/ 'dod rgyal thog ma'i ming gang yin// nges tshig gzhi med chos nyid bzhin// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rjes su grub pa'i ming la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ sngar tha snyad grub zin pa'i ming gang zhig /don gzhan gyi ming du btags pa de'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ rjes grub 'dod rgyal dang*/ don ldan gyi ming gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ rjes grub kyi ming gang zhig /sgra bshad du mi rung ba de'o/ /gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ khyi nag po la dung zhes brjod pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa rjes grub don ldan gyi ming la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ rjes grub kyi ming gang zhig /sgra bshad du rung ba de'o/ /gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ khyi dkar po la dung zhes brjod pa'i sgra lta bu'o/ /des na thog ma'i ming la 'dod rgyal gyi ming gis khyab cing*/ rjes grub kyi ming la 'dod rgyal dang don ldan gnyis ka srid pa yin te/ smra sgo las/ thog ma 'dod rgyal ming yin te// rjes grub dang ni don ldan dag/ 'dod rgyal gnyis kar 'dod pa yin// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ yang ming de la dbye na/ dngos ming dang*/ btags ming gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dod rgyal thog ma'i ming ngam dngos kyi sgra bshad gsum po gang rung tshang ba de'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ 'dod rgyal thog ma'i dngos ming dang*/ rjes grub 'dod rgyal gyi dngos ming*/ don ldan 'khrul med kyi dngos ming dang gsum du yod do//

gnyis pa btags ming la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ don ldan gyi ming gang zhig /btags pa'i sgra bshad lnga po gang rung tshang ba'i ming de'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas pa dang*/ 'brel ba rgyu mtshan du byas pa dang*/ de gnyis ka las zlog pa rgyu mtshan du byas pa'i btags ming gsum du yod do/ /dang po 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas pa ni/ sman bya rog rkang zhes brjod pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa 'brel ba rgyu mtshan du byas pa la/ rgyu ming 'bras bu la btags pa/ 'bras ming rgyu la btags pa/ tshogs pa'i ming ya gyal la btags pa/ ya gyal gyi ming tshogs pa la btags pa dang bzhir yod/ gsum pa de gnyis ka las zlog pa rgyu mtshan du byas pa'i btags ming ni/ gza' mig dmar la bkra shis dang*/ byed pa bi ṭi la bzang po zhes brjod pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa tshig la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi gdags gzhi yi ge du ma 'dus nas don gyi khyad par tsam ston par byed pa de'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ tshig bsdu ba dang*/ tshig gi phrad gnyis so/ /dang po la/ sgrub pa'i bsdu ba dang*/ dgag pa'i bsdu ba gnyis su yod/ gnyis pa tshig phrad la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ /dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang kho nas brjod bya'i don ston par mi nus shing*/ tshig gzhan zhig dang phrad nas don ston dgos pa de'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ tshig phrad so so ba dang*/ 'dus pa gnyis su yod de/ sgra gang rang la don med cing*// don ldan ming tshig gsal byed pa// tshig gi phrad yin de yang ni// so so ba dang 'dus pa gnyis// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yi ge la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ ming tshig gnyis kyi gdags gzhir gyur pa'i rjod byed de/ yi ge'i mtshan nyid yin te/ sum cu pa las/ ming tshig brjod pa kun gyi gzhi// yi ge zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ sgra'i bstan bcos las 'byung ba dang*/

sdeb sbyor gyi bstan bcos las 'byung ba dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo las 'byung ba dang gsum du yod/ dang po ltar na/ dbyangs kyi yi ge/ gsal byed kyi yi ge/ de las gzhan pa'i yi ge dang gsum du yod do/ /gnyis pa sdeb sbyor gyi bstan bcos las 'byung ba ltar na/ dbyangs yig la nyi shu rtsa gnyis dang*/ gsal byed la sum cu rtsa bdun du yod de/ sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung ldan las/ 'dir ni dbyangs yig nyi shu gnyis// gsal byed rnams kyang sum cu bdun// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gsum pa dus kyi 'khor lo las 'byung ba ltar na/ dbyangs thams cad stong pa chen po yi ge lnga dang*/ gsal byed thams cad thig stong yig drug tu 'dus pa yin te/ stong pa chen po yi ge lnga// thig le stong pa yi ge drug/ ces bshad pa'i phyir/ dang po stong pa chen po yi ge lnga ni/ a i u ri li rnams so/ /gnyis pa thig le stong pa yi ge drug ni/ sde pa drug po rnams so/ /rnam 'grel mdzad pa'i lugs ltar na/ ming tshig yi ge gsum ka mnyan bya yin/ zer ba ni ma shes pa yin te/ byed pa rnams kyi sbyor ba 'am// yid kyi bzlas pa don med 'gyur// zhes rig byed kyi tshig la sgras khyab pa la dngos skyon 'phangs pa'i phyir/

rang gi lugs ni/ ming tshig gnyis la ldan pa ma yin pa'i 'du byed kyis khyab cing*/ gsal byed srog yig dang bral ba rnams sgra ma yin la/ dbyangs bcu bzhi po rnams ni sgrar 'chad dgos te/ yi ge kun slong shes pa las// skye la shes pa'i sgra skye 'o// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ lnga pa 'gal ba dang 'brel ba'i rtogs tshul la/ 'brel ba dang*/ 'gal ba gnyis/ dang po 'brel ba la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba/ 'brel ba nges byed kyi tshad ma bshad pa gsum/ dang po la/ gzhan lugs mi 'thad pa dang*/ rang lugs bzhag pa gnyis/ dang po la/ bod phyi ma dag khyod chos de la tha dad/ chos de khegs na khyod khegs dgos de/ khyod chos de dang 'brel ba'i mtshan nyid yin/ zhes zer ba ni gzhung gi dgongs pa ma yin te/ de ltar na dngos ma nges dang*/ lhag ldan dang*/ 'gal ba'i gtan tshigs rnams gtan tshigs yang dag tu gyur te/ phyogs chos grub cing rtags chos la 'brel ba grub pa'i gtan tshigs yin pa'i phyir/ yang rigs gter las/ chos gang chos gzhan mi 'dor ba// 'brel ba rnams kyi spyi mtshan yin// zhes gsungs so//gnyis pa rang lugs bzhag pa ni/ chos de la rjes su 'gro ldog mi 'khrul ba de/ chos de la 'brel ba'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ bdag gcig 'brel dang*/ de byung 'brel ba gnyis su yod/ 'brel ba la de gnyis su grangs nges pa yin te/ 'di dngos rang bzhin nam 'bras phyir// 'di las rnam par zlog pas kyang*// 'khrul pa med pa yod ma yin// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ dang po bdag gcig 'brel la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ chos de dang ngo bo gcig pa'i sgo nas chos de la rjes su 'gro ldog mi 'khrul ba de/ chos de dang bdag gcig gi 'brel ba'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ dngos po dang mi rtag pa'i 'brel pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa de byung 'brel ba la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ chos de la ngo bo tha dad pa'i sgo nas chos de la rjes su 'gro ldog mi 'khrul ba de/

chos de dang de byung 'brel gyi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ me du'i 'brel ba lta bu'o/ /yang 'brel ba la dbye na/ mtshan nyid pa dngos po stobs zhugs kyi 'brel ba dang*/ btags pa ba sgro btags kyi 'brel ba gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rtsa ba dngos 'brel nges byed kyi tshad ma grub pa'i sgo nas rjes su 'gro ldog mi 'khrul ba de'o// gnyis pa dbye ba la/ dngos phyogs kyi dngos po stobs zhugs kyi bdag gcig 'brel dang*/ de'i de byung 'brel gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ dngos 'brel dang*/ brgyud 'brel gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ byas mi rtag gi 'brel ba dang*/ gnyis pa brgyud 'brel ni/ byas pa yod pa dang mi rtag pa yod pa'i 'brel ba lta bu'o// gnyis pa de byung gi 'brel ba la yang*/ dngos phyogs kyi 'brel ba dang*/ ldog phyogs kyi 'brel ba gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ dngos kyi 'brel ba dang*/ brgyud pa'i 'brel ba gnyis su yod/ dang po ni/ me du'i 'brel ba dang*/ gnyis pa brgyud pa'i 'brel ba ni/ me yod dang du yod kyi 'brel ba lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ldog phyogs kyi 'brel ba ni/ me med dang du med kyi 'brel ba lta bu'o// gnyis pa sgro btags kyi 'brel ba la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rtsa ba dngos 'brel nges byed kyi tshad ma la ma brten par rjes su 'gro ldog mi 'khrul ba tsam du bzhag pa de'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ de'i bdag gcig 'brel dang*/ de'i de byung 'brel gnyis su yod/ dang po ni/ mtshan mtshon gyi 'brel ba lta bu 'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'gog lam gyi 'brel ba lta bu'o// gsum pa 'brel ba nges byed kyi tshad ma bshad pa la/ rang bzhin gyi rtags kyi 'brel ba nges byed bshad pa/ 'bras bu'i rtags kyi 'brel ba nges byed bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ byas mi rtag lta bu la mtshon na/ ltos med kyi rtags kyis rjes 'gro'i 'brel ba nges par byed/

gnod pa can gyi rtags kyis ldog pa'i 'brel ba nges par byed/ gnyis pa 'bras bu'i rtags kyi 'brel ba nges byed bshad pa la/ ma dmigs pa sngon du 'gro ba'i phrugs gsum gyis rjes 'gro'i 'brel ba dang*/ dmigs pa sngon du 'gro ba'i phrugs gsum gyis ldog pa'i 'brel ba nges par byed do// gnyis pa 'gal ba la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ gzhan lugs mi 'thad pa dang*/ rang lugs bzhag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bod phyi ma rnams/ khyod chos de la tha dad/ khyod kyang yin chos de yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun mi srid pa de'o/ /zhes zer ba ni mi 'thad de/ de ltar na me du gnyis 'gal bar thal ba dang*/ rnam grol lam dang bar chad med lam 'gal bar thal ba dang*/ byams pa dang ma rig pa gnyis 'gal bar thal ba dang*/ 'dod chags dang khong khro gnyis 'gal bar thal ba dang*/ kun rdzob dang don dam gnyis 'gal bar thal ba rnams 'jug go/ gnyis pa rang lugs ni/ khyod chos de dang rjes su 'gro ldog phyin ci log tu nges pa de'o// gnyis pa dbye ba la/ mtshan nyid pa lhan cig mi gnas 'gal dang*/ btags pa ba phan tshun spang 'gal gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ khyod chos de la gnod byed du tshad mas dmigs pa'i sgo nas khyod chos de dang lhan cig tu gnas mi rung ba de/ khyod chos de dang lhan cig mi gnas 'gal yin pa'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ gnod byed tsha reg stobs chen po dang gnod bya grang reg gi rgyun ma 'ongs pa lta bu'o// yang 'gal ba mtshan nyid pa de la dbye na/ dngos 'gal dang*/ brgyud 'gal lo/ /dang po ni/ gnod byed me dang*/ gnod bya grang reg lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa brgyud 'gal ni/ gnod byed me dang gnod bya ba mo'i reg pa dang*/ grang 'bras spu long byed dang*/ grang rgyu nus pa thogs med lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa phan tshun spang 'gal la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/

dang po ni/ khyod chos de dang 'gal ba gang zhig /khyod dang chos de gnyis ka'am gang rung cig dngos por ma grub pa de/ khyod chos de dang phan tshun spang 'gal yin pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ dngos 'gal dang*/ brgyud 'gal gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ mi rtag pa dang rtag pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ byas pa dang rtag pa lta bu la byed de/ rang min 'gog pa dngos 'gal yin// brgyud 'gal rang min khyab bya 'gog/ ces bshad pa'i phyir/ drug pa mtshan nyid dang mtshon bya'i rtogs tshul la/ mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum ngos bzung ba dang*/ mtshon sbyor ji ltar 'god pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la/ mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum las/ dang po mtshan nyid la/ lo chen dang*/ rgya dmar ba ni/ mtshon bya rnam 'jog mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid yin/ zhes gsungs/ slob dpon phya pa ni/ rdzas yod chos gsum tshang ba mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid dang*/ rigs gter ba/ dngos 'gal gcod pa'i don ldog tu grub pa mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid yin/ zhes dang*/ rang lugs la/ mtshan nyid dngos dang*/ mtshan nyid kyi skyon gsum bsal ba'o/ /dang po ni/ slob dpon phya pa dang mthun/ gnyis pa mtshan nyid kyi skyon gsum bsal ba la/ ma khyab/ khyab che/ mi srid pa'i skyon gsum yod pa las/ dang po ma khyab pa'i skyon ni/ mtshan nyid gang zhig /rang gi mtshan gzhi'i phyogs gcig la ma khyab pa'o/ /dper na ba lang gi mtshan nyid du nog lkog shal khra bo bkod pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa khyab che ba'i skyon ni/ mtshan nyid gang zhig /rang gi mtshan gzhi ma yin pa gzhan la yang khyab pa ste/ dper na/ ba lang gi mtshan nyid du don byed nus pa bkod pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa mi srid pa'i skyon ni/ mtshan nyid gang zhig /rang gi mtshan gzhi la mi srid pa ste/ nog lkog shal rta'i mtshan nyid du bzhag pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa mtshon bya la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po la/ slob dpon phya pa ltar na/ btags yod chos gsum tshang ba mtshon bya'i mtshan nyid dang*/

rigs gter ba ltar na/ rgyu mtshan can gyi sgra blos grub pa mtshon bya'i mtshan nyid yin/ zhes 'chad/ gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ ka ba dang bum pa la sogs pa'i ming rnams so// gsum pa mtshan gzhi la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ mtshan mtshon zung cig gi rten byed pa de'o/ /gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ bum pa dang ka ba lta bu'o/ /de gnyis mtshon byar 'jog pa'i tshe de gnyis kyi ming mtshon byar 'jog pa yin gyi/ rang ldog nas mtshon byar mi 'jog ste/ de gnyis dang don byed nus pa sogs la rdzas yod dang btags yod yin min gyi khyad par med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mtshon sbyor ji ltar 'god pa'i tshul la/ rtsa ba'i sbyor ba dang*/ de las bcu gnyis su 'gyur ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ bum pa mtshan gzhi/ dngos po'i tha snyad dang ldan par mtshon/ don byed nus pa yin pa/ zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa de las bcu gnyis su 'gyur ba'i tshul la/ rang ldog yin pa'i mtshon tshul drug dang*/ gzhan ldog yin pa'i mtshon tshul drug ste bcu gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ spyi'i sbyor ba gsum dang*/ sbyor ba 'dir gtogs gsum ste drug go/ /gnyis pa gzhan ldog yin pa'i mtshon tshul drug la yang de gnyis su phye bas drug go/ /blo rigs kyi rnam par gzhag pa rdzogs so// // 'di ni sde bdun gzhung gi snying po ste// rigs pa'i lam mchog 'jug pa'i sbyor ba yin// rtog ge'i lus brgyad gsal ba'i me long dang*// dgag sgrub yal 'dab 'phel ba'i rtsa ba'ang yin// 'dis kyang rtog ge'i ring lugs gnas pa las// dngos dang brgyud pas cha shas 'phen gyur cig / khyad par 'dren mchog skyes chen dam pa yi// thugs kyi bzhed pa ma lus yongs gang nas// bdag kyang 'phral dang yun du bde gyur cig/ ces gsung rab kun la lta ba'i mig gcig rgya chen thos pa 'tshol ba'i snang bar gyur pa rgyas pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi rang don dang gzhan don gyi le'u las 'byung ba'i rtags dang sgrub ngag gi rnam gzhag

tshad ma grub pa dang mngon sum gyi le'u las 'byung ba'i tshad ma spyi dang mngon rjes so so'i rang bzhin gtan la phab pa 'di yang*/ dpal rnam thos kyi ri bo'i 'dab/ gang dbyar chab 'bab pa'i 'gram/ gdan sa chen po chos kyi pho brang dang nye bar/ rje btsun dbang phyug rdo rje'i bka' lung nye bar byin pa la brten nas dge sbyong gi gzugs brnyan 'dzin pa rnam rgyal grags pas sbyar ba'o// //
